notes.title: Major Demo Update for Retro Relics
notes.content: [h2]Retro Relic's Demo just received a major update![/h2][h2][/h2][p]I heard your feedback and worked hard on getting out this new patch for the game and the demo available to play. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]There has been a major overhaul of the graphics:[/b][/h3][p]I added a soft and gradient lighting system to visualize sunrays and making the visuals cozier and smoother. There are also new cloud shadows randomly passing through the levels.[/p][p]I added a Graphics tab to the settings, so you can enable and disable the new graphic style to your likings.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079850/456c9ef5fd6be1ded8e0af39ebeb3914ac55bef9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]I completely reworked the excavation mini game:[/b][/h3][p]I got a lot of feedback on the digging / excavation mini game. It was often bugged with dirt patches not reacting to digging because of overlapping. Most of you also just dug away all of the dirt everytime and the Pinpointer mini detector was useless.[/p][p]I know increased the number of dirt lumps to over 1000 and you can just dig away everywhere right ahead. Now you really need to locate the relic first with the help of the pinpointer.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079850/a7afe708b1b22897bfbfae94d79b20572daa7072.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]I added a first implementation of Localization to new languages:[/b][/h3][p]Retro Relics can now be played in English, German, Italian, French and Swedish. You can choose the language in the main menu or in the pause menu. Translations are work in progress and might be imperfect as of now. I will continously work on these.[/p][h3][/h3][h3][b]Fixed several bugs and added QoL functionalities[/b][/h3][p]Many of you also reported bugs or gave feedback on missing functionality that should be implemented in every game. I heard you and changed lot of systems. I fixed game crashes, item duplication glitches and improved the polish of the game. E.g. you can now click through the dialogues without having to hit the arrow. Much more has been improved.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who played the demo! it makes me very proud that I got so far and so many of you enjoyed playing Retro Relics.[/p][p][/p][p]I will post announcements and updates here more often as we are nearing the full release of Retro Relics.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy Hunting![/p][p]HistoryXPlorer [/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: Movement Update Demo V0.17.3
notes.content:
Hello Relic Hunters!

It's been a week since the release of my demo for "Retro Relics". Many of you have already played the game and there were a few issues that were reported related to the movement system.

I listened carefully and worked hard to get these annoying issues solved.
Demo Version 0.17.3 can now be downloaded (it will download automatically) and I have fixed following things:

[h2]Update Log Version 0.17.3:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with player being stuck in walls and objects
[*] Improved the running ability: You can now run with Shift or B-button no matter what tool you have selected or where you are. You can even sprint in the basement. It will automatically change back to your last used tool :)
[*] Added hotbar clicking: You can now simply clicked on the tool in the hotbar and it will select it, of course you can still scroll or use the tool number :)
[*] Fixed a few more minor spelling errors etc.
[/list]

If you want to report any more issues or want to help me with new ideas, please come to our small, but very friendly Discord server:

[url=https://discord.gg/Br2GZHtDPQ]Discord Link[/url]

notes.title: Retro Relics Demo private beta test has just started!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everybody![/h3]

Great news for [b]Retro Relics[/b]. The beta test phase for the official demo has just started. 
As of today, the demo version Beta 0.15 of my game has just been pushed to Steam. 
[b]
The beta test will be private and if you're interested in participating, please join my Discord server :)[/b]

You can receive a private key for testing purposes and take part in my beta test. Feedback and ideas are very important to me and my community plays an extremely important role in the development of Retro Relics.

[h3][b]What can you expect from the beta version?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 intro levels to introduce the player to the mysterious background story of Retro Relics and teach him how to use the metal detector to find relics
[*] 2 main levels including two missions
[*] 1 unlockable animal by collecting trash
[*] building mode to decorate your museum room with displays
[*] more than 40different relics to find
[/list]
[h3][b]How can you take part?[/b][/h3]

If you want to become a beta tester and help me make a better demo and also be one of the first testers of Retro Relics, please join my small Discord community:
[url=https://discord.gg/Br2GZHtDPQ]Discord Link[/url]

Thank you for reading and I hope to see you in the beta test!

Your HistoryXPlorer

notes.title: Devlog update: You can choose to play as a female or a male detectorist now!
notes.content:
[h1]Devlog Announcement:[/h1]

Hello fans and friends of [b]Retro Relics[/b], the relaxing treasure hunting and metal detecting adventure.
I'm glad to announce that you will be able to choose to play as female or a male metal detectorist.
For this I recently implemented a new female main character to the game,

[h2]Check it out:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079850/9c89504f2ef48c0fe92a7cea1638883473d050ab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079850/021ab331b866ce7cc7f23853c7dd612232644264.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates. I really want to push forward to releasing a first playable demo.
If you want to know more about the development process or want to contribute your own ideas, be welcome on our small community [b]Discord [/b]server:

https://discord.gg/9Sf3TdcnXG


Have a nice weekend!
~HistoryXPlorer
